messages:
rachel: Heads-up everyone: we're retiring a100x Dedicated pools in MEL & SYD and replacing them with L40e clusters next month. Decommission window: May 18-20. This is a planned migration to reduce operational overhead and improve inference throughput for common chat workloads.

samir: Timeline + impact? Do customers need to take action or will routing be seamless?

rachel: Short version: we will migrate existing reservations to L40e-compatible pools where possible. For customers using custom drivers or Private deployments, action is required (see runbook). We'll do staged cutovers per region to minimize disruption.

leo: Important policy change: after decommission, we'll no longer accept new A100x reservations in MEL/SYD and existing reservations will be honored until cutover. We're introducing a mandatory compatibility check during reservation renewal: "compat_check=1" in the CLI will validate driver/runtime compatibility.

ops-bot: Runbook published: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/a100x-to-l40e-mel-syd-migration (internal) :link: 

samir: Migration guidance for customers: 1) enable kv-prefix caching, 2) test fp16 vs bf16 model variants in staging, 3) set request_timeouts=120s for long-context models during cutover. We also recommend pinning short critical windows using reservation tags.

rachel: Billing note: for seats/commits covering the decommission window we're offering a one-time migration credit equal to 25% of next month's dedicated charges for affected accounts. Preview customers will see a temporary billing tag "migration_credit_applied". Billing will communicate details to account owners.

billing: Confirmed. We'll emit credit line items and include a migration_credit label in the Console cost breakdown. Expect billing entries within 7 business days after cutover.

leo: For Private deployments: driver stack requirement changes. L40e requires driver v8.1.x+ and runtime shim 3.4.0. Private customers must schedule upgrades before May 15 or request an exception. We posted a compatibility matrix and an upgrade checklist in the runbook.

ops-bot: Deprecation notice: a100x images will remain available for 48h post-cutover for final draining, then images and routing rules removed. Please avoid creating new A100x-based workloads after May 10.

samir: Rollback/fallback: during migration we'll maintain an emergency fallback to a nearby A100x pool in BNE for a short window, but it's best to test on L40e now.

rachel: Pilot nominations: PMs, please send pilot account ids to ops by May 1 if you want priority migration scheduling. Ops will coordinate reserved slots for migration testing.

leo: Metrics to watch: cold_start_ms, avg_p99_latency, kv_cache_hit_rate, and migration_errors. Dashboards updated in Dedicated > Pools > MEL/SYD > Migration.

rachel: TL;DR: A100x decommission in MEL & SYD May 18-20, L40e will replace, runbook + CLI compat_check, migration credits available, Private must upgrade drivers by May 15. Ping ops or DM me for pilot slots. :white_check_mark:
